name: memorysync
description: Persistent memory for Codex: hooks capture the durable facts in your prompts and inject recalled context per prompt, with the MemorySync MCP server for search, save, list, update and delete.

interface.shortDescription: Automatic long-term memory for AI coding sessions
interface.longDescription: MemorySync gives Codex durable memory: lifecycle hooks send every prompt for fact extraction the moment you submit it, storing only the durable facts in it (Codex's replies are not stored), retry prompts the network refused when the turn ends, and inject relevant memories at session start and per prompt — scoped to you and your repository, session-safe by contract (memory being down can never break a session). Includes the full MemorySync MCP tool set and memory skills.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about this project?
Remember that I prefer small, focused pull requests
Search my memories for decisions about the API design
